## Summary

Describe the change and link it to the iteration goal.

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] This PR represents one feature or another independently reviewable increment, not an agent role.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are listed and addressed.
- [ ] The branch and commit subjects use neutral, feature-focused names.
- [ ] Tests/lint/typecheck/build and configured CI checks are listed with their actual results.
- [ ] Database or API contract changes are documented.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or prohibited company naming was added to source, artifacts, screenshots, or logs.
- [ ] This branch/PR is safe to be visible publicly, including while marked draft.
- [ ] AI contributions, human decisions, and review evidence are recorded honestly in the workflow ledger.
- [ ] User-facing and operational failure states are covered where relevant.

## Risks and follow-up

List unresolved issues, assumptions, and the next validation gate.
